text:
toni: Heads-up, micro-launch plan for the 'Inference Playbook' webinar next Tue. We want a 3-post cadence on X + a LinkedIn carousel. Who can take lead on the scheduling and seedlist?
harry: I can take scheduling in Hootsuite. Proposed times: primer 7:45am PT, main 10:40am PT, follow-up Wed 9:15am PT.
yasmin: Ill craft 4 copy variants (tease, benchmark, ops-play, invite). Need the exact metric phrasing from eng before publishing.
jules: Creative can export 1200x628 + 1080x1080 + a 6-slide PDF for LI carousel. Also can make a short 3s looping GIF for X.
toni: Key metrics to call out: "~35% lower inference cost" and "2x throughput at comparable p99" but legal wants the word 'approx' in front. Will confirm.
harry: Tracking UTMs: utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_playbook_may2026&utm_content=postA. Ill append to CTA.
yasmin: Draft snippets: 
- Tease: "Free playbook: scale reliable LLM inference. Live Tue 11am PT. Register -> short.link/ip"
- Benchmark: "Independent tests show ~2x throughput vs baseline at similar p99. Join our demo Tue 11am PT"
- Ops-play: "How we routed requests to hit p99 SLOs and cut costs. Live Tue 11am PT"
- Invite: "Seats limited  Register now for the playbook demo: short.link/ip"
harry: I'll schedule drafts by Mon 3pm PT. Please upload final images + alt text to the Hootsuite assets folder.
jules: Dropping assets here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/inference_playbook_assets.zip. Alt text included for each size.
sdr-bot: Routing rule request received. If utm_campaign=inference_playbook_may2026 -> assign queue:webinar-nurture, tag:social_playbook, owner_rotation:eu-us-sdrs.
toni: Growth asked for $1k paid to boost the benchmark post. Approve?
harry: Recommend $700 on benchmark, $300 on Wed follow-up.
yasmin: Note: for LinkedIn we should use the carousel + short TL;DR post; not the long thread. Ill prepare carousel captions.
jules: Also adding a pinned comment on X with registration link and TL;DR bullet list.
toni: Legal: @olivia can you review the copy once I flag the drafts? Need sign-off on metric phrasing.
olivia: Happy to review. Tag me in the drafts.
harry: Checklist for scheduling: final copy per channel, creatives in correct crop, CTA short.link/ip, UTM, approval flag.
yasmin: Ill add image alt-text and micro-CTAs per platform.
toni: Thanks team. Quick sync Mon 4pm PT to confirm final assets. :rocket:
